newsitem.title: USA: Stock market snaps losing streak.
newsitem.headline: Stock market snaps losing streak.

text.p: Wall Street stocks ended in the plus column Monday, snapping a three-session string of losses that stemmed from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's remarks last Wednesday about high stock prices.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 41.18 points at 6,918.92. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a slim margin on moderate volume of 434 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
